description: Jupiter aggregator quote on Solana for an exact-input swap: input and output amounts in base units, price impact %, USD value, slippage, and the AMM route legs (venue labels). Quote only, no transaction. Amounts stay in the token's smallest unit (decimals are not looked up). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

amount.description: Amount to sell in the smallest unit (lamports for SOL)

inputMint.description: Mint to sell (base58), e.g. SOL wrapped mint So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112

slippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points, 1 to 1000 (default 50)
